settings2.cal.help.google.back: To see ProjectLead in Google: “Other calendars” → + → “From URL”, paste your iCal link.
settings2.cal.help.google.name: Google Calendar
settings2.cal.help.google.steps: In Google Calendar, open the calendar's settings, “Integrate calendar” section, and copy the “Secret address in iCal format”.
settings2.cal.help.icloud.back: To see ProjectLead on Mac or iPhone: File → “New Calendar Subscription”, paste your iCal link.
settings2.cal.help.icloud.name: iCloud (Apple)
settings2.cal.help.icloud.steps: In Calendar on iCloud.com, share the calendar as a “Public Calendar” and copy the link (webcal://…).
settings2.cal.help.outlook.back: To see ProjectLead in Outlook: “Add calendar” → “Subscribe from web”.
settings2.cal.help.outlook.name: Outlook / Microsoft 365
settings2.cal.help.outlook.steps: In Outlook on the web: Settings → Calendar → Shared calendars → “Publish a calendar”, choose “Can view all details” and copy the ICS link.
settings2.cal.intro: See ProjectLead in your usual calendar, and your other calendars in ProjectLead.
settings2.cal.removeText: Its events disappear from the ProjectLead Calendar; the original calendar is not affected.
